note: USACE campground on an open peninsula of Milford Lake near Thunderbird Marina. The tip of loop B (B-028 to B-031) and the north row (B-005 to B-007) sit on the riprap shore; tent-only sites are off by themselves to the north. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + live catalog: $14/$24 confirmed, 50 A (loop A) / 30 A (loop B) with water, 65 sites (53 electric, 6 non-electric RV, 6 tent), 3 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets, 14-in-30 max and soft 3-night holiday minimum. Lakefront stands; pin OK. Season not stated (calendar opens Apr 15).
